SOCIOL 208B Social Networks Methods

A Graduate Reading Seminar in Social Network Analysis.

  Syllabus and Readings

  • The course syllabus.
    • This is the main document where you will find information about the course, assignments, and requirements
  • The course reading schedule.
    • Schedule of readings we will be doing this quarter (check for changes). 
  • pdfs of class readings.
    • The Google Drive folder containing pdf files of the readings we will do in class.

Greatest Hists Article Explainers

  • White, H. C., Boorman, S. A., & Breiger, R. L. (1976). Social Structure From Multiple Networks. I. Blockmodels of Roles and Positions. American Journal of Sociology, 81(4), 730–780.

    • Definition of structural equivalence
    • How blockmodeling works

  • Breiger, R. L. (1974). The Duality of Persons and Groups. Social Forces, 53(2), 181–190.

    • How matrix multiplication works
    • Two-mode network analysis

  • Freeman, L. C. (1978). Centrality in social networks conceptual clarification. Social Networks, 1(3), 215-239.

    • How centrality works

Organizations and Resources

  • International Network for Social Network Analysis (INSNA)
    • Main professional association for researchers interested in social network analysis.
  • The Network Science Society
    • Main professional association for researchers interested in network science across the physical, biological, social, mathematical, and computational sciences.
  • Historical Network Research
    • A platform for scholars who study historical networks.
  • Social Network Analysis (SNA) Hub
    • A resource hub is dedicated to all things Social Network Analysis (SNA) curated and maintained by members of the Social Network Analysis in Scotland (SNAS) Group at the University of Edinburgh's School of Social and Political Science. 

Some Useful Links

  • Visualizing Historical Networks
    • Website for a network visualization project devoted to mapping "the way people in the past interacted with each other and their surroundings."
  • Social Network Data Repository
    • A network Data Repository with Interactive Graph Analytics and Visualization.
  • Stanford Large Network Dataset Collection
    • A network data repository maintained at Stanford University.
  • UCINET data sets.
    • Collection of social network data sets associated with the network analysis software UCINET.
  • Data Repositories Maintained by Specific People
    • Tore Opsahl
    • Mark Newman

Network Journals  

  • Connections (Journal)
    • Official journal of the International Network for Social Network Analysis.
  • Journal of Social Structure
    • Online journal of INSNA publishing interdisciplinary research on the area of social structure.
  • Social Networks (Journal)
    • Top specialist venue for the latest theory, research, and methodological developments in social network analysis.
  • The Journal of Historical Network Research
    • New journal devoted to the study of networks from a specifically historical perspective.
  • Network Science (Journal)
    • Interdisciplinary journal dedicated to the study of networks. 

Reference Works and Further Reading   

  • The Oxford Handbook of Social Networks
    • Most recent (2021) major handbook summarizing the field (UC library account required for access).
  • The SAGE Handbook of Social Network Analysis
    • Oldie (2011) but goodie major handbook summarizing the field (UC library account required for access).
  • The Development of Social Network Analysis
    • An accessible, sociologically-informed intellectual and institutional history of the field written by one of the founders.
  • Understanding Social Networks: Theories, Concepts, and Findings
    • A non-technical introduction to the core ideas and theories in the field written by an early adopter of the perspective.
  • Network Science
    • Open access textbook on Network Science written by one of the pioneers in the field.
